result.summary: 本文提出了 Movie Gen，一组媒体生成基础模型，能够生成 1080p 高清视频及同步音频，并支持基于指令的视频编辑和基于用户图像的人物个性化视频生成 [abstract]。模型在文本到视频、视频个性化、视频编辑、视频到音频和文本到音频等多个任务上取得了新的最优结果 [abstract]。最大的视频生成模型是 30B 参数的 Transformer，最大上下文长度为 73K 视频 token，对应 16 秒、16 FPS 的视频 [abstract]。作者在架构、潜在空间、训练目标、数据筛选、评估协议、并行化和推理优化等方面进行了多项技术创新和简化，以从数据、模型规模和计算量的扩展中获益 [abstract]。作者希望这项工作能帮助研究社区加速媒体生成模型的进展和创新 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在为 AI 系统赋予生成、组合和预测能力，并以图像、视频、音频作为输出空间，构建媒体生成基础模型 [S1.p1]。作者认为，扩展训练数据、计算量和模型参数，并使用简单的 Transformer 和 Flow Matching 训练，能够产生高质量的媒体生成模型 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Equipping AI systems with such generative, compositional, and prediction capabilities is a core scientific challenge with broad applications.
While Large Language Models (LLMs) aim to learn such capabilities with a text output space, in this paper we focus on media – image, video, audio – as the output space.
We find that scaling the training data, compute, and model parameters of a simple Transformer-based model trained with Flow Matching yields high quality generative models for video or audio.

method.text: Movie Gen 包含两个基础模型：30B 参数的 Movie Gen Video 用于联合文本到图像和文本到视频生成，13B 参数的 Movie Gen Audio 用于视频和文本到音频生成 [S2.p2]。视频模型在时空压缩的潜在空间中生成，使用时间自编码器（TAE）进行 8 倍压缩，并采用 Flow Matching 训练目标和基于 LLaMa3 的 Transformer 骨干 [S3.p2][S3.SS1.SSS1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS3.p3]。音频模型采用基于 Flow Matching 的扩散 Transformer（DiT）架构，条件包括视频、音频上下文和文本 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.SSS1.p1]。个性化通过后训练实现，编辑能力则通过多阶段训练获得，无需监督视频编辑数据 [S2.p3][S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: We achieve these wide capabilities using two foundation models: • Movie Gen Video. A 30B parameter foundation model for joint text-to-image and text-to-video generation
• Movie Gen Audio. A 13B parameter foundation model for video- and text-to-audio generation
For improved training and inference efficiency, we perform generation in a spatio-temporally compressed latent space.
we compress the input 8× across each of the spatio-temporal dimensions
We build our Transformer backbone by closely following the Transformer block used in the LLaMa3 architecture.
We adopt the flow-matching based generative models and the diffusion transformer (DiT) model architecture.
We add video personalization and video editing capabilities to our foundation Movie Gen Video model via post-training procedures
we introduce Movie Gen Edit, a model that achieves state-of-the-art results in video editing, and outline our approach for training it without any supervised video editing data.

experiments.text: 视频模型在约 1 亿视频-文本对和约 10 亿图像-文本对上预训练，并经过多阶段训练和高质量视频微调 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]。评估使用人工 A/B 测试，并发布了包含 1003 个提示的 Movie Gen Video Bench 基准 [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1]。音频模型在约 100 万小时音频上预训练，并在高质量数据上微调，评估使用 Movie Gen Audio Bench 等数据集 [S2.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]。个性化模型在约 100 万文本-视频对上训练，编辑模型在图像编辑数据和多阶段合成数据上训练 [S4.SS2.SSS1.p1][S5.SS1.SSS2.p1][S5.SS1.SSS3.p1][S5.SS1.SSS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our pre-training dataset consists of O(100)M video-text pairs and O(1)B image-text pairs.
we employ a multi-stage training procedure
we publicly release a benchmark, Movie Gen Video Bench, which consists of 1003 prompts
We pre-train the model on O(1)M hours of audio
we propose to release a benchmark Movie Gen Audio Bench
This processing provides us with O(1)M text-video pairs where a single person appears
we leverage an image editing dataset, treating image editing as single-frame video editing.
we create two complementary datasets that do include multi-frame videos inputs and outputs.
we create video editing data with real output videos.

findings.text: Movie Gen Video 在文本到视频生成的整体质量上显著优于 Runway Gen3 和 LumaLabs，对 OpenAI Sora 有中等净胜，与 Kling1.5 持平 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。在真实感和美学上，Movie Gen Video 显著优于 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs 和 Kling1.5，并对 OpenAI Sora 有显著或中等净胜 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p3]。个性化模型在身份保持、视频质量和文本对齐上显著优于 ID-Animator [S4.SS5.p1]。Movie Gen Edit 在 TGVE+ 基准上的人类评估中比 EVE 被偏好超过 74% [S5.p3]。Movie Gen Audio 在音效生成、音乐生成和音频扩展上优于包括 PikaLabs 和 ElevenLabs 在内的先前工作 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond 2σ.
Our generations moderately net win over OpenAI Sora (8.23%) (net win rate within 1-2 σ) and are on par with Kling1.5 (3.87%).
On realness and aesthetics, Movie Gen Video significantly outperforms Runway Gen3, LumaLabs and Kling1.5 on both metrics, with 48.49%, 61.83% and 37.09% net win rates on realness, respectively.
Compared to OpenAI Sora, Movie Gen Video has a significant win on realness with 11.62% net win rate beyond 2σ and a moderate win over OpenAI Sora on aesthetics with 6.45% net win rate within 1–2 σ.
our method significantly outperforms the baseline by a large margin in all axes of identity preservation, video quality, and text alignment.
We demonstrate that human annotators prefer Movie Gen Edit more than 74% of the time when compared to the previous state-of-the-art on the TGVE+ benchmark.

Movie Gen Audio, outperforms prior state-of-the-art, including commercial systems such as PikaLabs and ElevenLabs for sound-effect generation (table 31), music generation (table 32), and audio extension.

limitations.text: 作者指出，视频生成模型在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理和状态转换等方面仍存在伪影 [S8.p2]。生成的音频在运动密集、视觉上较小或被遮挡、或需要更细粒度视觉理解时有时会不同步，且当前不支持语音生成 [S8.p2]。使用人工评估定义客观标准仍然具有挑战性，可能受到个人偏见等因素影响 [S8.p2]。模型分别针对视频和音频生成训练，联合生成这些模态是重要的研究方向 [S8.p2]。此外，模型仅支持英语文本输入，且部署前需要安全改进 [S8.p3]。

evidence.quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.

Generated audio is sometimes out of synchronization when motions are dense (e.g., tap dance), visually small or occluded (e.g., footsteps), or when it requires finer-grained visual understanding (e.g., recognizing the guitar chords).
It currently does not support voice generation either due to our design choices.

defining objective criteria evaluating model generations using human evaluations remains challenging and thus human evaluations can be influenced by a number of other factors such as personal biases, backgrounds etc.
While our models are trained separately for video and audio generation, developing models that can generate these modalities jointly is an important area of research.
Our study in this paper is limited to text inputs in the English language.
The Movie Gen cast of foundation models were developed for research purposes and need multiple improvements before deploying them.
